```yaml
name: Build macOS DMG

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-macos-dmg:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pyinstaller
          # Install any other build dependencies required by sshpilot
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

      - name: Import Code Signing Certificates
        uses: apple-actions/import-codesign-certs@v2
        with:
          p12-file-base64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12 }}
          p12-password: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          keychain-password: ${{ secrets.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build Universal Binary
        run: |
          # Create build directory
          mkdir -p build/universal

          # Build for x86_64 (Intel)
          echo "Building for x86_64..."
          pyinstaller --name sshpilot-x86_64 --clean --noconfirm sshpilot.spec 2>/dev/null || \
          pyinstaller --name sshpilot-x86_64 --clean --noconfirm --onefile main.py 2>/dev/null || \
          echo "Note: Adjust pyinstaller command based on your project structure"
          
          # Build for arm64 (Apple Silicon)
          echo "Building for arm64..."
          pyinstaller --name sshpilot-arm64 --clean --noconfirm sshpilot.spec 2>/dev/null || \
          pyinstaller --name sshpilot-arm64 --clean --noconfirm --onefile main.py 2>/dev/null || \
          echo "Note: Adjust pyinstaller command based on your project structure"

          # Create universal binary using lipo
          # Note: This step assumes you have built separate binaries for each architecture
          # In a real scenario, you might need to cross-compile or use a runner that supports both
          if [ -f "dist/sshpilot-x86_64/sshpilot" ] && [ -f "dist/sshpilot-arm64/sshpilot" ]; then
            lipo -create -output build/universal/sshpilot dist/sshpilot-x86_64/sshpilot dist/sshpilot-arm64/sshpilot
          else
            echo "Warning: Could not create universal binary. Check build outputs."
            # Fallback: copy one of the binaries if universal creation fails
            if [ -f "dist/sshpilot-x86_64/sshpilot" ]; then
              cp dist/sshpilot-x86_64/sshpilot build/universal/sshpilot
            elif [ -f "dist/sshpilot-arm64/sshpilot" ]; then
              cp dist/sshpilot-arm64/sshpilot build/universal/sshpilot
            fi
          fi

      - name: Create DMG
        run: |
          # Install create-dmg if not available
          brew install create-dmg || true

          # Prepare app bundle structure
          mkdir -p "sshpilot.app/Contents/MacOS"
          mkdir -p "sshpilot.app/Contents/Resources"
          
          # Copy universal binary to app bundle
          if [ -f "build/universal/sshpilot" ]; then
            cp build/universal/sshpilot "sshpilot.app/Contents/MacOS/sshpilot"
            chmod +x "sshpilot.app/Contents/MacOS/sshpilot"
          fi

          # Create Info.plist
          cat > "sshpilot.app/Contents/Info.plist" << EOF
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
          <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
          <plist version="1.0">
          <dict>
              <key>CFBundleName</key>
              <string>sshpilot</string>
              <key>CFBundleIdentifier</key>
              <string>com.mfat.sshpilot</string>
              <key>CFBundleVersion</key>
              <string>1.0.0</string>
              <key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key>
              <string>1.0.0</string>
              <key>CFBundleExecutable</key>
              <string>sshpilot</string>
              <key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key>
              <string>10.15</string>
          </dict>
          </plist>
          EOF

          # Create DMG
          create-dmg \
            --volname "sshpilot" \
            --volicon "sshpilot.app/Contents/Resources/icon.icns" \
            --window-pos 200 120 \
            --window-size 800 400 \
            --icon-size 100 \
            --icon "sshpilot.app" 200 190 \
            --hide-extension "sshpilot.app" \
            --app-drop-link 600 185 \
            "sshpilot.dmg" \
            "sshpilot.app/"

      - name: Upload DMG Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sshpilot-macos-dmg
          path: sshpilot.dmg
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        with:
          files: sshpilot.dmg
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
```
